identity.name: Calatrava
identity.one_liner: The hobnail-bezel Calatrava reborn at 39mm on a new twin-barrel manual caliber.

narrative.story: The 6119 of 2021 brought back the Clous de Paris bezel of the 3919 — the definitive 1980s-90s Calatrava — but grew it to 39mm and built a movement for it: the 30-255 PS, a new manual caliber with two barrels, 65 hours of reserve and a full-width bridge layout that fills the caseback view. Rose gold 6119R with silver dial, white gold 6119G with charcoal.
narrative.collector_notes: The hobnail bezel collects polish damage badly — inspect the pyramid edges under a loupe. This is the current-production dress Patek most often available at retail without a long wait.
